about_the_game:
Legend has it that 200 mischievous cats have scattered themselves across the country’s most iconic spots — and it’s your mission to find them all. From bustling city streets to peaceful natural areas, explore 2 beautifully hand-drawn maps, solve puzzles solo or with a friend, and color each scene in a calm and relaxing environment.

WHAT YOU’LL LOVE

  • Each map reflects the unique texture, city atmosphere, and cultural details of the region.

  • You can relax by coloring with guided numbers or a free color palette.

  • 200 cats await you, hiding in every corner.

  • Team up with a friend in local two-player mode or with remote co-op support.

  • Light lo-fi music and ambient sounds calm your exploration and creativity.

  • Share your art in the community gallery, vote for others, and join monthly contests.

  • Easy-to-use controls, adjustable zoom, and color-blind-friendly palettes make it accessible to everyone.
